definitions.explanation: The side that is on the right when facing forward.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{右側|みぎがわ}を{歩|ある}いてください。
examples.english: Please walk on the right side of the road.

examples.japanese: {右側|みぎがわ}の{棚|たな}に{資料|しりょう}が{並|なら}んでいます。
examples.english: Documents are lined up on the right-side shelf.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}を{過|す}ぎたら、{右側|みぎがわ}に{大|おお}きな{公園|こうえん}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: After passing the intersection, you'll see a large park on the right side.

notes:
{右|みぎ} (right) + {側|がわ} (side). Used to specify the right-hand side of a road, building, body, or any spatial reference point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右側|みぎがわ}を{歩|ある}く: walk on the right side
- {右側|みぎがわ}に{寄|よ}る: move to the right side
- {右側|みぎがわ}{通行|つうこう}: right-side traffic
- {体|からだ}の{右側|みぎがわ}: right side of the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {左側|ひだりがわ}: left side — the opposite direction
- {右手|みぎて}: right hand, but also used to mean "on the right" in directional contexts
- {右|みぎ}: right — more general, while {右側|みぎがわ} specifically emphasizes the side

USAGE:
In Japan, pedestrians walk on the {右側|みぎがわ} of the road when there is no sidewalk, while vehicles drive on the left. This is the opposite of many other countries.
